entries.title: I Samuel 8:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass when Samuel was old that he made his sons judges over Israel.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:2
segments: The name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; [they were] judges in Beersheba.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:3
segments: But his sons did not walk in his ways; they turned aside after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:4
segments: ¶Then all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah,

entries.title: I Samuel 8:5
segments: and said to him, "Look, you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations."

entries.title: I Samuel 8:6
segments: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." So Samuel prayed to the LORD.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:7
segments: And the LORD said to Samuel, "Heed the voice of the people in all that they say to you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me, that I should not reign over them.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:8
segments: "According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt, even to this day-with which they have forsaken Me and served other gods-so they are doing to you also.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:9
segments: "Now therefore, heed their voice. However, you shall solemnly forewarn them, and show them the behavior of the king who will reign over them."

entries.title: I Samuel 8:10
segments: So Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people who asked him for a king.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:11
segments: And he said, "This will be the behavior of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint [them] for his own chariots and [to be] his horsemen, and [some] will run before his chariots.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:12
segments: "He will appoint captains over his thousands and captains over his fifties, [will set some] to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and [some] to make his weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:13
segments: "He will take your daughters [to be] perfumers, cooks, and bakers.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:14
segments: "And he will take the best of your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, and give [them] to his servants.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:15
segments: "He will take a tenth of your grain and your vintage, and give it to his officers and servants.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:16
segments: "And he will take your male servants, your female servants, your finest young men, and your donkeys, and put [them] to his work.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:17
segments: "He will take a tenth of your sheep. And you will be his servants.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:18
segments: "And you will cry out in that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and the LORD will not hear you in that day."

entries.title: I Samuel 8:19
segments: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, "No, but we will have a king over us,

entries.title: I Samuel 8:20
segments: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles."

entries.title: I Samuel 8:21
segments: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he repeated them in the hearing of the LORD.

entries.title: I Samuel 8:22
segments: So the LORD said to Samuel, "Heed their voice, and make them a king." And Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Every man go to his city."
